analysis.reason: RSI 44.1에서 58.4로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램도 -1.2102에서 -0.0577로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호. 5일 연속 양봉 마감하며 Higher Low 패턴 지속 중. 현재가 $227.38은 스윙 저항선 $227.92에 근접하나, 상승 모멘텀이 유지되고 있어 돌파 시도 가능성.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44.1 to 58.4, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -1.2102 to -0.0577, signaling bottoming. Five consecutive positive days maintain the Higher Low pattern. Current price $227.38 is near swing resistance $227.92, but upward momentum suggests a potential breakout attempt.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-1.2102→-0.0577): 약세에서 강세 전환 신호 포착

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($208.93): 50일 이동평균선($214.40) 기반 지지력 확인

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.91배): 정상 수준 거래량으로 움직임 신뢰도 유지
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): RSI 과매도 탈출 및 Higher Low 패턴 지속으로 매수 진입 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($227.38) vs SMA5/20/50 ($219.01/$219.36/$214.40): Above short/mid-term moving averages, confirming bullish position.
· 14.69% above SMA100/200 ($211.62/$198.25): Maintaining mid/long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (87.3%): Entering a strong zone near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.1→58.4): Exited oversold territory and progressing towards neutral zone consolidation.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2102→-0.0577): Signal of transition from bearish to bullish momentum detected.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $232.35, Middle $219.36): Approaching upper band while trading above the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($208.93): Support confirmed based on the 50-day moving average ($214.40).
· Swing resistance ($227.92): Current price approaching, expecting further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low): Confirmation of continued uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.91x): Normal volume levels maintain confidence in price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met due to RSI exiting oversold and continuation of Higher Low pattern.
